messages.author: 8fc2bc9cca049463
messages.subject: Parser error...help!
parts:
OK, I think I've done something stupid and just can't see it. Here is my transformed parameters block:

transformed parameters {
  cov_matrix[2] SIG;
  vector[2] mu[J]; 
  vector[J] alpha;
  vector[J] beta;
  SIG[1,1] <- pow(sig.a,2);
  SIG[1,2] <- rho*sig.a*sig.b;
  SIG[2,1] <- rho*sig.a*sig.b;
  SIG[2,2] <- pow(sig.b,2);
 
  for (j in 1:J) {
    mu[j][1] <- delta_0 + delta_1*LC[j];
    mu[j][2] <- gamma_0 + gamma_1*LC[j];
    alpha[j] <- alpha_beta[j][1];
    beta[j]  <- alpha_beta[j][2];
  }

}

For some reason I'm getting this error from the parser

Error in stanc(file = file, model_code = model_code, model_name = model_name,  : 
  failed to parse Stan model 'model01' with error message:
EXPECTATION FAILURE LOCATION: file=input; line=32, column=5

    mu[j][1] <- delta_0 + delta_1*LC[j];
    ^-- here


DIAGNOSTIC(S) FROM PARSER:
Parser expecting: "}"

I can't see why I would need a curly brace where it's indicating. Any thoughts?

parts:
Thanks for reporting.

That's a bug. I'll file an issue.

The problem is that the way it's implemented,
mu[j] returns an Eigen::Block. I need to implement
the getter for blocks that returns an LHS reference.

- Bob
